I lined up all 101 North Texas towns with at least 150 sales. Fairview's typical sale is down 16.3% from the year before. Rhome, Sanger and Aubrey dropped too. University Park, Trophy Club and Euless went up.

The Fairview math: a typical sale of $567,000 now, down 16.3%, puts last year's typical sale around $677,000. A typical price also moves when a different mix of homes sells, so check your own street before you price off last year.

Based on data from the North Texas Real Estate Information Systems (NTREIS) for the period November 2, 2025 to November 2, 2026. Deemed reliable but not guaranteed. Not intended to solicit properties currently listed with another broker.
Photo: MisterElection2001, CC0, via Wikimedia Commons.
Kevin Grant, Pax Realty.
